name: Jeshurun
overview: Jeshurun is a poetic name for Israel that highlights God's chosen people and their relationship with Him. Scripture portrays Jeshurun as favored by God, who formed and chose them (Isaiah 44:2), and over whom God reigns as king (Deuteronomy 33:5). Yet, the name also reflects moments of Israel's unfaithfulness, as Jeshurun is described as growing complacent and forsaking the Rock of salvation (Deuteronomy 32:15). Ultimately, Jeshurun underscores the unique and powerful help of God toward His people (Deuteronomy 33:26).
